shared_goal: Together the two teams are documenting a small to-do list HTTP API. The guide must match the spec exactly.

teams.name: spec
teams.goal: Design the API: write FINAL.md (under 400 words) specifying 4-6 endpoints for a to-do list service (method, path, request and response JSON, error codes). Publish the spec to the other team as shared/api-spec.md and answer their questions. Your goal is met when the guide team confirms the spec is clear enough to document.

teams.name: guide
teams.goal: Write FINAL.md (under 400 words): a user guide for the to-do list API with one example request per endpoint. You do not design the API: get the spec from the spec team, ask them about anything unclear, and make sure every endpoint in the guide matches their spec exactly.
